title: Minecraft Java 1.16.5 Released
author: Adrian Östergård
imageAltText: An image of a forest biome, with a lit Nether Portal inside of it. Alex stands in front of it, ready to face the newly converted Zoglin.
description: Install Minecraft Java 1.16.5 and make sure your launcher is set to the "Latest Release" option. This release fixes critical stability issues.

blocks.source_text: Happy Friday! We're now releasing 1.16.5, which fixes two critical stability issues. We are not releasing more information about these issues at this time to protect servers that have not yet updated.

blocks.source_text: This release is network compatible with 1.16.4 - this means you do not need to upgrade your game right away to play on an upgraded server. However, we highly encourage all server owners to update as soon as possible to apply the stability fixes.

content:
Happy Friday! We're now releasing 1.16.5, which fixes two critical stability issues. We are not releasing more information about these issues at this time to protect servers that have not yet updated.

This release is network compatible with 1.16.4 - this means you do not need to upgrade your game right away to play on an upgraded server. However, we highly encourage all server owners to update as soon as possible to apply the stability fixes.

Next week, we aim to release the next snapshot of Caves & Cliffs. Stay tuned!

Get the Release

​To install the release, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/download) and click play! Make sure your Launcher is set to the "Latest Release" option.

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://launcher.mojang.com/v1/objects/1b557e7b033b583cd9f66746b7a9ab1ec1673ced/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker!](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)

Want to give feedback?

Head over to our  [feedback website](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)  or come chat with us about it on the  [official Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft) .
translated_content:
周五快乐！我们目前正在发布 1.16.5 版本，该版本修复了两个关键的稳定性问题。为了保护尚未更新的服务器，现阶段我们不会透露关于这些问题的更多信息。

此版本与 1.16.4 版本在网络兼容性方面没有问题——这意味着你不必立即升级游戏就能在已升级的服务器上玩游戏。不过，我们强烈建议所有服务器所有者尽快更新，以应用这些稳定性修复。

下周，我们计划发布 “Caves & Cliffs” 的下一个快照版本。敬请期待！

获取最新版本

​要安装最新版本，请打开 [Minecraft 启动器](https://www.minecraft.net/download)，然后点击 ‘开始游戏’(play)! 确保你的启动器设置为 ‘最新版本’(Latest Release) 选项。

跨平台服务器 jar 文件：

[Minecraft 服务器 JAR 文件](https://launcher.mojang.com/v1/objects/1b557e7b033b583cd9f66746b7a9ab1ec1673ced/server.jar)

[Minecraft 问题跟踪器！](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary)

想要提供反馈吗？

请访问我们的[反馈网站](https://feedback.minecraft.net/)，或者在[官方 Minecraft Discord](https://discord.gg/Minecraft)上与我们交流。
